# AllShots

> AllShots is event photo sharing made for weddings and ready for every milestone: birthdays, graduations, proms, homecoming, baby showers and parties. The host shares one QR code; guests scan it and start shooting, with no app or account needed, and every photo and video lands in one live album the host controls. Every event starts free for up to 10 guests. When the guest list grows, the host buys a one-time package for that event; no subscription needed.

## How it works for hosts

- Create your event in the AllShots iPhone app (iOS 16.4 or later) or on a computer in the host dashboard at https://host.allshots.app/. Name it, add the date and choose how many shots each guest gets. You don’t need an account to start.
- Your QR code is ready in the app. Pick one of 12 invitation and table-card designs with your QR code built in: save it to Photos to print, or share it with the invite.
- Choose a shared album, where everyone who joins can browse every photo, or a private album, where guests keep shooting and only you see the whole album.
- Every photo lands in one live album as it’s taken. Delete any photo from the album; anything a guest reports is hidden at once while it’s reviewed. End the event when the night is over, and uploads stop.
- Download every photo and video as one ZIP, on every plan, free included.

## How it works for guests

- Scan the QR code, or type the 6-character code at https://allshots.app/app/. A page opens in the phone’s browser, on iPhone or Android; tap Photo and the phone’s own camera opens. There’s nothing to install.
- No account, no password: guests can add a name or stay anonymous.
- Any modern phone browser works. Guests with the iPhone app can use it instead, and everything lands in the same album.
- Disposable mode: no preview and no retakes, every shot uploads the moment it’s taken, and each guest gets a set number of shots (10, 12, 24, 36, 48 or 72, or unlimited shots on the Unlimited plan). The no-preview camera is in the iPhone app; guests in a browser use their phone’s own camera, with the same shot count.
- On Medium and Unlimited, guests can also leave a written note or a voice message from the browser.

## Pricing

Pay once, per event. Start free; all plans are one-time purchases for a single event, and nothing renews. Prices are in US dollars and may vary by region; local taxes may apply at checkout.

- Starter: Free. Up to 10 guests, 50 photos, live shared gallery, QR & 6-character code, photos kept 7 days after the first upload.
- Small: $3.99 / event. Up to 20 guests, unlimited photos, no automatic deletion, everything in Starter.
- Medium: $14.99 / event. Up to 50 guests, unlimited photos, memory book (written notes from guests), voice memories (spoken messages), everything in Small.
- Unlimited: $29.99 / event. Unlimited guests, video capture (videos up to 90 s), everything in Medium.

Every plan includes the live shared gallery, QR & code, disposable mode and a full album download (ZIP).

- In the app: buy in the AllShots iPhone app and pay with your Apple ID. Apple is the seller; billing and refunds go through the App Store.
- On the web: pay by card from the host dashboard at https://host.allshots.app/. Create your event there, or pick a free one, and choose a plan. Web purchases are sold by Paddle, reseller and merchant of record, and appear in the app on the same event within minutes. Same prices, same plans; Paddle may show your local currency and tax at checkout.
- Need a bigger plan later? You can move the same event to a bigger plan in the iPhone app at any time; nothing your guests have added is lost. The bigger plan is charged at its full price, so pick the plan that fits your guest list from the start.
- Host often? Monthly and annual plans are in the app.

## Use cases

- [Birthday party photo sharing: one album for every guest’s photos](https://allshots.app/use-cases/birthday-party-photo-sharing.html): Kids’ parties, milestone birthdays and surprise parties: one QR, one album, no chasing.
- [Corporate event photo sharing: collect photos from attendees with a QR code](https://allshots.app/use-cases/corporate-event-photo-sharing.html): Offsites, holiday parties and conferences: attendee photos in one controlled album, no app on work phones.
- [Baby shower photo app: one album, every guest’s photos, plus their messages](https://allshots.app/use-cases/baby-shower-photo-app.html): Photos from every guest and a memory book of notes and voice messages, from one QR code.
- [Graduation party photo sharing: every guest’s photos in one album](https://allshots.app/use-cases/graduation-party-photo-sharing.html): Open houses and backyard parties: one QR at the door, every guest’s photos in one album.
- [Prom photo sharing: one album for the whole night](https://allshots.app/use-cases/prom-photo-sharing.html): Pre-prom photos, the dance and the after-party in one album, with the committee in control.
- [Homecoming photo sharing: the game, the dance and the reunion in one album](https://allshots.app/use-cases/homecoming-photo-sharing.html): One code for the whole weekend: parade, game, dance and the alumni tailgate.
- [Party photo sharing app: every guest’s photos in one live album](https://allshots.app/use-cases/party-photo-sharing-app.html): Dinner parties, engagements, retirements, reunions: one QR, one live album.
- [Christmas party photo sharing: one QR code, every guest’s photos](https://allshots.app/use-cases/christmas-party-photo-sharing.html): One QR code by the tree; guests join from the phone’s browser and every photo lands in one album.
- [New Year’s Eve party photo sharing: every phone, one album](https://allshots.app/use-cases/new-years-eve-party-photo-sharing.html): The countdown from every corner of the room, in one album by morning.
- [Thanksgiving and Friendsgiving photo sharing with one QR code](https://allshots.app/use-cases/thanksgiving-friendsgiving-photo-sharing.html): Three generations at one table; grandparents join from the browser, with no app or account.

- [POV Alternative: AllShots vs POV (2026)](https://allshots.app/compare/pov-alternative.html): prices by guest count and features side by side, and when POV is the better pick.
- [GuestPix Alternative: AllShots vs GuestPix (2026)](https://allshots.app/compare/guestpix-alternative.html): plans, original files, slideshow and hosting, and when GuestPix is the better pick.
- [Wedibox Alternative: AllShots vs Wedibox (2026)](https://allshots.app/compare/wedibox-alternative.html): plan by plan, and when Wedibox’s RSVP, seating chart and wedding website make it the better pick.
- [Kululu Alternative: AllShots vs Kululu (2026)](https://allshots.app/compare/kululu-alternative.html): upload limits, how long photos stay and the live photo wall, and when Kululu is the better pick.
